headline: You are welcome here.
subheadline: Come worship with us, ask questions, find community, and join us in serving our neighbors. All are Welcome.
welcomeHeading: A church rooted in worship and open to everyone
welcomeText: Epiphany is a community of people learning to follow Jesus together. Whether you have been part of the Episcopal Church for years, are returning to church, looking for your first church experience, or are simply curious, you are welcome to join us.
serviceText: Our Sunday service begins at 10:00 AM. Come as you are. Visitors are welcome to participate as much or as little as they are comfortable.
outreachText: Faith takes us beyond Sunday morning. Epiphany supports local neighbors through hands-on outreach, partnerships, and practical care.

sundayService.heading: Sunday Eucharist Service
sundayService.priestBio:
The Rev. Canon Virginia Heistand was ordained in 1991. One former parishioner remarked that it sometimes feels as though she attended seminary in the 1940s, thanks to the wisdom and stories passed down from her family, which included two bishops and two additional priests — all of whom still get quoted often!  

She and her husband, Jim Wilson, are a “love at last” couple whose family includes five children, three in-law children, and three precious grandchildren (though she says to stay tuned in case the count increases).  

After 35 years in parish ministry, Reverend Virginia considers it a true joy to continue serving the church through supply ministry.

closingHeading: There is a place for you here.
closingText: Visit on Sunday, join us online, or reach out if you have a question before you come.
